# Collider

> > Collider is an entertainment news and analysis publication covering streaming series, films, TV recaps, trailers, and pop culture across Netflix, Hulu, Prime Video, and major studios.

Collider provides daily coverage of television episodes, movie releases, streaming platform trends, and entertainment industry news. The site features episode recaps, film analysis, trailer breakdowns, and rankings spanning genres from sci-fi thrillers to romantic comedies, with particular focus on streaming success stories and franchise developments.

## Key Topics

- Netflix original series
- Streaming platform trends
- TV episode recaps
- Film analysis and rankings
- Sci-fi thrillers
- Romantic comedies
- Season premieres and finales
- Trailer announcements
- Character analysis
- Hulu originals
- Prime Video content
- Marvel Studios
- Rotten Tomatoes ratings
- Streaming success metrics
- Entertainment industry news
